changes: Selected structures; original low-resolution OBJ triangulation converted to metre-based position/normal buffers; named structures grouped without remeshing. Original CT pose retained. Blender 5.2 LTS decimation per semantic structure and smooth-normal regeneration; no remapping of labels. Detailed source geometry is reduced; qualified visual/anatomical review remains pending. Degenerate triangles removed; exceptional zero-length vertex normals use geometric face normals.
axes: X anatomical left, Y superior, Z anterior
limitations: Single adult source anatomy; no child or infant model.
Low-resolution surfaces; no skin histology, injury simulation, rigging or validated physiological animation.
Skeletal system includes a remainder group; not every bone has an individual label.
Colour is illustrative; original scan-derived surfaces have no photographic texture.
Expanded regional muscle coverage is source-limited; grouped remnants are not individually labelled. This is not a complete anatomical atlas.
Lung surfaces are a separately licensed 4.3 subset in the 4.x coordinate system; qualified alignment and anatomical review remain pending.
